forbid.message: React fires its leave only after a pointerout, and the browser sends none when the node under the pointer was removed. Listen for the native pointerleave with addEventListener, as use-canvas-pointer.ts does. A stable element that never unmounts under the pointer may opt out with a lint-disable comment that gives the reason.
